steps.en: Owner is sent the 2nd-reminder SMS or email
steps.id: Pemilik individu dikirimi SMS/email reminder ke-2
steps.why_en: The SMS/email sending job is switched off in the prod configuration, so automatic sending does not run.
steps.why_id: Job pengirim SMS/email dimatikan di konfigurasi prod, jadi pengiriman otomatis tidak jalan.

steps.en: An owner who opted out gets no e-reminder
steps.id: Pemilik yang opt out tidak dikirimi e-reminder
steps.why_en: The opt-out check exists but sits in the sending job that is switched off in the prod configuration.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan opt out ada, tetapi ada di job pengirim yang dimatikan di konfigurasi prod.

steps.en: NRIC owners due for the 3rd reminder are picked for checking
steps.id: Pemilik NRIC yang jatuh tempo reminder ke-3 dipilih untuk dicek

steps.en: Owners with a foreign ID are checked in DataHive
steps.id: Pemilik berID asing dicek ke DataHive
steps.why_en: The DataHive check job for FIN is switched off in the prod configuration; it is on in UAT.
steps.why_id: Job pengecekan DataHive untuk FIN dimatikan di konfigurasi prod; di UAT menyala.

steps.en: The latest address is saved for the owner's letter
steps.id: Alamat terbaru disimpan untuk surat pemilik

steps.en: The 3rd reminder is built and sent to the printer
steps.id: Reminder ke-3 dibuat dan dikirim ke pencetak
steps.why_en: The letter is built, but printer delivery is blocked in prod while the stage still advances.
steps.why_id: Letter dibuat, tetapi pengiriman ke pencetak diblok di prod sementara tahap tetap maju.
